# Gene Ontology and Enrichment

## Load packages and SNP differentiation data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)

library(org.Dm.eg.db)
library(TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene)

FF_results <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/FF_results.RDS")
```

## Retrieve annotated genes and map target SNPs

```{r}
# filter all significant sites
significant_sites <- FF_results %>% filter(lm_AdjPval < 0.05)

# load Drosophila melanogaster genomic architechture
txdb <- TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene
# load all D. melanogaster genes coordinates data
genes_data <- genes(txdb)

# function to map SNP data to genes based on coordinates
map_snp2gene <- function(SNP_data, gene_coords){
  gr_data <- GRanges(
    seqnames = SNP_data$CHROM,
    ranges = IRanges(start = SNP_data$POS, end = SNP_data$POS)
  )
  
  
}
```
